# FileTextResponse

The text extracted from a file.

**Kind:** an object, used in responses.

## Fields

Every field is present in a response; empty ones are `null`.

| Field | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `text` | `string` | The file's extracted text. |

## Example

```json
{
  "text": "..."
}
```

## Where it's used

- [`files.text`](../api/files.md) (`GET /files/by-id/{id}/text`)
